aux_contact_tip: The AUX dry contacts can be set to normally open or normally closed, and support working by time or auto-trigger: ON mode: the contacts are closed within the set time and disconnected outside the time. OFF mode: The contact is disconnected within a set time and closed outside the time. AUTO mode: Contacts automatically switch according to system operating conditions (regardless of time setting)
aux_setting_notice1: Note:The feed-in power of switch-on should be more than that of switch-off.
aux_setting_notice2: The contact is only opened/closed if the power fulfills the set conditions for longer than this time.
aux_setting_notice3: After switching on, do not switch off in the given time.
aux_setting_notice4: After switching off, do not switch on in the given time.
delay_time_hint: Minutes to wait before switching on/off
soc_setting_hint:
When SOC is set on 'at least' mode, the AUX contact point of load need to be connected to N/O point. When SOC is in the setting range (regardless of setting delay)N/O point will be closed ( connect to the load ), if the feed-in power is higher than the 'Switch On' power. N/O point will be disconnected (disconnect from the load), if the feed-in power is lower than the ‘Switch Off’ power or that from grid No operation needed if the feed-in power is between 'Switch On' and 'Switch Off' power.
 When SOC is set on 'at most' mode, the AUX contact point of load need to be connected to N/C point. When SOC is in the setting range (regardless of setting delay) N/C point will be closed ( connect to the load ), if the feed-in power is higher than the 'Switch On' power. N/C point will be disconnected (disconnect from the load), if the feed-in power is lower than the 'Switch Off' power or that from grid. 'No operation needed if the feed-in power is between 'Switch On' and 'Switch Off' power.
ups_mode_hint: After activation, the AUX function can still be used when the system is off-grid
